# David Norton

> Portfolio of David Norton, a senior software engineer focused on frontend development who designs and builds interfaces for complex web applications.

## Pages

- [Home](https://davidnorton.app/): Senior software engineer in London
- [Landinsight](https://davidnorton.app/work/landinsight): Consolidates ownership, planning, and property data into one platform, letting developers assess opportunities, reduce risk, and act with confidence.
- [Forestry TEP](https://davidnorton.app/work/ftep): Serves commercial, governmental and research users in the forestry sector. It enables easy access to satellite data from any global location.
- [MiniToTheMax](https://davidnorton.app/work/minitothemax): A miniature painting and tabletop hobby platform.
